This isn't quite a typo in the documentation, but it's similar from a usability perspective:

docs#ZMod.val_one' is documented as proving that ZMod.val 1 = 1. The theorem only applies when the ZMod modulus is zero, but the documentation has no indication of that; you have to view the source code to see what the theorem says.

(The source code says (1 : ZMod 0).val = 1, but the documentation "simplifies" this to 1.val = 1.)

Yes, the pretty-printer can hide important details, this is a tough known problem.
I don't think this is related to the current thread though.
